title: Open-plan start presentation
description: How an open TaskPlan waits for the owner and which tasks have a useful Start These Directly rule to remember. Computed once by the server on every open-plan read or event; never stored and absent from older hubs (#17853).

PlanStartReason.description: Why an open plan still waits for Start: outbound_confirmation, private content or the track's outbound policy; owner_step, money, an outward action or an irreversible step; request_gate, request prerequisites; continuation, a continuation gate an authorized supervisor cannot release; start_authorization, ordinary start authority is missing. Closed: a newer value decodes as unknown and offers no trust rule.

PlanStartView.description: Server-computed presentation of an open TaskPlan, carried as its optional start field. remember contains zero-based indexes of writable tasks not covered by tasks.trust, and is present only when reason is start_authorization. An empty or omitted remember offers no checkbox. Absence of the whole start field is the legacy-hub compatibility path.

reason.description: Why this open plan waits for the owner.

remember.description: Zero-based task indexes for which Start These Directly can usefully remember a tasks.trust kind; omitted or empty when there are none.
